From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing deck & estimate — Redwood Inference

Hey Olivia / Nate —

Thanks again for taking time to chat today. Quick recap from our discovery call:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for your recommendation pipeline while hitting 99th percentile latency < 120ms.
- Current constraints: mixed batch sizes, 8x GPUs in prod, strict data residency for EU customers (won't apply to initial rollout).
- Success metric: 30% reduction in per-token cost while keeping quality within 3% of current model outputs.

I attached the pricing deck and a short estimate based on the usage profile you shared. Highlights:
- Estimated monthly spend (pilot): $13,200 — assumes 2 million tokens/day with batching and prefix caching.
- Dedicated plan options with reserved capacity for predictable throughput.
- Suggested next step: 30-minute walkthrough of the deck + mutual action plan to scope a 6-week pilot.

Attachments: pricing_deck_redwood_v2.pdf (slide summary + estimate tab)

Are you available for a quick walkthrough this week or early next? I can do:
- Thu 5/6 10–11am PT
- Fri 5/7 1–3pm PT
- Tue 5/11 9–11am PT

If those don't work, tell me a couple times that do and I will send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference — reliable, cost‑efficient LLM inference for production teams
